title: Typed Optional-State Layout Identity & Fail-Closed Runtime Contract
scope_statement: F-MR41 types already-qualified optional physical-state layout identities and makes unknown layout identities fail closed. It does not add physics, a new state family, a new solver, or canonical admission.

invariants.name: one computational kernel
invariants.evidence: No kernel source changed; F-MR39 exact runtime authority remains byte-output identical under the typed contract.
invariants.rationale: The change is confined to runtime template identity/admission and restart matching.

invariants.name: kernel independent of I/O
invariants.evidence: Only runtime core, serialized runtime admission, and restart-state matching changed; no I/O or parsing code changed.
invariants.rationale: No file, path, unit, or format dependency was introduced into the kernel.

invariants.name: explicit data separation
invariants.evidence: optional_state_layout_id remains template metadata and numerical_continuation_layout_id remains a separate numerical-policy axis.
invariants.rationale: Physical optional-state topology is now explicitly typed rather than inferred from an arbitrary positive integer.

invariants.name: compact persistent state
invariants.evidence: FMR41_INACTIVE_TYPED_CAPABILITY_SEMANTICS=PASS; typed snow/thermal templates may match a column with no allocated optional state.
invariants.rationale: A template capability ID does not force optional state allocation for inactive columns.

invariants.name: scratch per worker
invariants.evidence: No workspace or scratch ownership code changed; F-MR39 exact runtime output remains unchanged.
invariants.rationale: F-MR41 introduces constants and admission checks only.

invariants.name: scalable memory layout
invariants.evidence: No per-column fields or persistent arrays were added; fmr_template_t field layout is unchanged.
invariants.rationale: Named integer constants replace implicit value ranges without increasing column state.

invariants.name: transactional timesteps
invariants.evidence: F-MR39 transactional runtime oracle replays exactly and retains its expected SHA256.
invariants.rationale: Checkpoint, trial, commit, rollback, and retry code paths were not modified.

invariants.name: cheap recomputation and warm start
invariants.evidence: No committed/trial state or warm-start mechanism changed.
invariants.rationale: Typed state-layout identity affects admission only.

invariants.name: generic time
invariants.evidence: No interval or calendar logic changed.
invariants.rationale: No time assumptions are introduced by layout typing.

invariants.name: flexible coupling windows
invariants.evidence: No coupling-window or interval contract changed.
invariants.rationale: The workunit is orthogonal to coupling-window size.

invariants.name: coupling as core functionality
invariants.evidence: No coupling transaction, interface residual, or response-tangent source changed.
invariants.rationale: Runtime layout identity remains compatible with existing coupling architecture.

invariants.name: explicit groundwater interface contract
invariants.evidence: No groundwater head/flux interface source changed.
invariants.rationale: F-MR41 has no groundwater-interface semantics.

invariants.name: absolute mass conservation
invariants.evidence: F-MR39 valid runtime output SHA256 is unchanged; F-MR19 base/restart preservation passes at O0 and O2.
invariants.rationale: No storage, flux, or mass-accounting formula changed.

invariants.name: interface sensitivities first-class output
invariants.evidence: No sensitivity or Jacobian interface source changed.
invariants.rationale: State-layout typing does not alter sensitivity production.

invariants.name: bounded coupling cost
invariants.evidence: No solver/coupling execution count logic changed.
invariants.rationale: Added checks are constant-time integer comparisons.

invariants.name: MultiSWAP primary use case
invariants.evidence: F-MR39 mixed enabled/disabled MultiSWAP oracle is replayed unchanged; FMR41_INACTIVE_TYPED_CAPABILITY_SEMANTICS=PASS.
invariants.rationale: The typed ID is template-level capability metadata and does not force state allocation on inactive columns.

invariants.name: no mandatory one-to-one MODFLOW relation
invariants.evidence: No tile, fraction, aggregation, or MODFLOW mapping source changed.
invariants.rationale: Optional-state typing is column-template local.

invariants.name: deep-vadose optional separate component
invariants.evidence: No deep-vadose component or transfer-zone source changed.
invariants.rationale: No new coupling between SWAP state and deep-vadose state was introduced.

invariants.name: mass-conserving component transitions
invariants.evidence: No component transition or storage-transfer code changed.
invariants.rationale: F-MR41 does not alter component handoff semantics.

invariants.name: alternative soil-water solvers remain open
invariants.evidence: No soil-water solver interface or implementation changed.
invariants.rationale: Optional-state topology remains runtime metadata independent of Richards implementation.

invariants.name: maximum reuse of SWAP physics
invariants.evidence: No physics module was copied, forked, or changed.
invariants.rationale: Existing snow and soil-temperature state families are referenced by identity only.

invariants.name: other modules do not depend on HeadCalc internals
invariants.evidence: No HeadCalc dependency was added; changed files contain only runtime/state-contract logic.
invariants.rationale: Hydraulic interface boundaries are untouched.

invariants.name: physics options separated from solver policy
invariants.evidence: FMR_OPTIONAL_STATE_LAYOUT_* identities are separate from FMR_NUMERICAL_CONTINUATION_* identities and the two fields remain distinct.
invariants.rationale: F-MR41 explicitly prevents arbitrary numerical/layout values from being interpreted as a physical optional-state capability.

invariants.name: predictable compute time
invariants.evidence: No nonlinear solve, fallback, retry, or iteration policy changed.
invariants.rationale: Admission adds only bounded constant-time checks.

invariants.name: reference mode remains available
invariants.evidence: Serialized reference backend remains operational; F-MR39 and F-MR19 reference-path tests pass at O0/O2.
invariants.rationale: No reference solver functionality was removed.

invariants.name: diagnostics are runtime functionality
invariants.evidence: Unknown-layout admission uses the existing KERNEL_STATUS_NOT_ADMITTED and admission_rejections diagnostics path.
invariants.rationale: F-MR41 fails closed through established diagnostics rather than silently coercing a layout.

invariants.name: optional functionality scales with use
invariants.evidence: FMR41_INACTIVE_TYPED_CAPABILITY_SEMANTICS=PASS and no new per-column storage is introduced.
invariants.rationale: A typed-capability template can serve inactive columns without allocating snow or thermal state.

invariants.name: runtime/coupler organizes system composition
invariants.evidence: Optional physical-state topology identities are centralized in runtime template metadata and checked at runtime/restart boundaries.
invariants.rationale: The kernel is not made aware of deployment composition or tile relations.

invariants.name: no silent dependencies
invariants.evidence: FMR41_UNKNOWN_POSITIVE_LAYOUT_FAIL_CLOSED=PASS and the mutated F-MR39 oracle using 390502 is rejected at O0 and O2.
invariants.rationale: The previous silent assumption 'any positive optional_state_layout_id means thermal' is removed.

invariants.name: audit every architecture change
invariants.evidence: This file explicitly assesses all 30 architecture invariants against candidate 50b8bd32b03946d947b9c8b87a17192684843b6e.
invariants.rationale: Scope boundaries and nonclaims are recorded rather than inferred.

bounded_nonclaims: F-MR41 does not requalify snow-process physics or the full historical F-MR06 snow runtime on current canonical source.
F-MR41 does not qualify a snow-plus-soil-temperature combined profile; that combination remains rejected.
F-MR41 does not add or qualify a new optional-state family or a new layout identity beyond the already evidenced base, snow, and restricted soil-temperature identities.
F-MR41 does not perform canonical admission or change RB1 release authority.
F-MR41 makes no performance or parallel-throughput claim beyond constant-time contract checks and preservation of existing qualified paths.
